title: CCXT Extract Override File
description: Per-exchange curated overrides. Each file lives at priv/overrides/<exchange_id>.json and carries hand-curated gap-fill entries addressed by RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the emitted exchange JSON. See SCHEMA.md § Override Contract for the full semantics.

schema_version.description: Override contract version. Independent of the exchange JSON's schema_version.

overrides.description: Non-empty list of override entries. Paths within a file must be unique (enforced by the loader, not by JSON Schema).

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the emitted exchange JSON (e.g. /structure/authenticated_sections).

value.description: Replacement value. Any JSON value; consumer-tier schemas validate shape at the target path.

reason.description: Why this override exists. Required — overrides without a reason rot silently.

verified_against.description: Optional source citation (file:line) or runtime probe reference proving the override matches real behavior. Mutually exclusive with "unverified": true.

unverified.description: Optional. Set true when the override is best-effort and has not been validated against runtime/source. Mutually exclusive with verified_against.
